home.title: Mindful Memories Initiative
home.description: Preserving dignity and joy for dementia patients through memory books, engagement kits, and community support.
home.heroTitle: Preserving Precious Memories, Bringing Joy to Dementia Patients
home.heroText: Discover the power of reminiscence therapy with personalized memory books, engagement kits, and meaningful connections.

sections.title: Our Mission
sections.content: To preserve precious memories and bring joy to dementia patients through personalized memory books, creating meaningful connections between patients, families, and caregivers.

sections.title: Our Vision
sections.content: A world where every person affected by dementia experiences dignity, connection, and joy through the power of preserved memories and compassionate care.

about.title: About Us
about.description: Learn about Mindful Memories Initiative, our founders, and our mission to support dementia care through memory preservation.
about.intro: Mindful Memories Initiative is a compassionate nonprofit organization dedicated to improving the lives of dementia patients through the power of reminiscence therapy.
about.content: Our flagship program, Pages of the Past, creates personalized memory books filled with photographs, stories, and meaningful moments from each patient's life. These carefully crafted books support reminiscence therapy and help patients reconnect with their memories.
about.quote: We believe that every person deserves to be remembered and celebrated.

programs.title: Our Programs
programs.description: Explore the programs that help dementia patients and families through memory books and cognitive engagement kits.
programs.intro: Our impact programs are designed to support emotional wellness, memory engagement, and meaningful connection for dementia patients.

items.title: Pages of the Past
items.description: Personalized memory books that preserve cherished life stories, photographs, and meaningful memories.

items.title: Cognitive Engagement Kits
items.description: Sensory-rich kits designed to reduce anxiety, stimulate memory, and support caregiver engagement.

items.title: Community Workshops
items.description: Educational workshops that help families, volunteers, and care teams learn how to use reminiscence activities effectively.

impact.title: Our Impact
impact.description: See how Mindful Memories Initiative brings measurable care and joy to dementia patients and their families.

stories.quote: The engagement kits have brought back a sparkle in my father's eyes that we hadn't seen in months.

stories.quote: Implementing Mindful Memories Initiative at our center has revolutionized how we approach personalized care.
